title: 60-Second Lead Response for Web Design Agencies
metaDescription: Give eligible web-design enquiries a first reply against a 60-second service target, with approved studio context, routing and your booking link.
excerpt: A lead-response workflow can give each web-design enquiry a fast, consistent first reply while routing project context to the right person.

sections.intro:
A project enquiry can arrive while the studio is deep in delivery work. A delayed reply creates an avoidable gap between the prospect's question and a clear next step.

The 60-Second Lead Engine is designed to send a personalized first reply against an agreed service target, include the appropriate booking link and alert the right designer or project manager. A human can review or take over when the enquiry needs judgement.

This is the Capabilities layer of an AI Operating System. We offer a focused first build so you can evaluate it on your own workflow before considering a wider system.
sections.fourCFit:
The 60-Second Lead Engine is a focused, measurable Capability for a studio. It depends on the other three Cs:

  • Context: approved examples and rules shape the studio's reply.
  • Connections: the agreed form, inbox, calendar and CRM trigger and record the workflow.
  • Capabilities: the reply itself, plus routing to the right account or project manager.
  • Cadence: optional follow-up runs on an agreed schedule and stops when the prospect replies.

See how it fits the wider AI Operating System for Web Design Agencies.
sections.whatDoneLooksLike:
The service target and controls are concrete:

  • Eligible enquiries trigger a first reply against the agreed 60-second target.
  • The reply uses approved project details, studio facts and voice examples.
  • The correct booking link is selected from current calendar rules.
  • The right designer or project manager receives the enquiry and a copy of the reply.
  • The CRM is updated using agreed matching and source-of-truth rules.

Optional follow-up runs on the agreed cadence and stops when the prospect replies or a person takes over.
sections.howWeInstall:
Three phases:

  1. Fit check. Confirm the lead source, project routing, available integrations, approved examples and human handoff.
  2. Install the Lead Engine. Connect the scoped form, inbox, calendar and CRM, then test expected and edge cases before enabling live sends.
  3. Operate, optional. Continue monitoring and improving the workflow or expand into a wider AIOS plan. See plans.
sections.expectedResults:
The build is evaluated against your own baseline and the service level agreed in scope.

  • Measure time from enquiry to first reply.
  • Check project routing and the facts used in each reply.
  • Track human takeovers, delivery failures and stopped follow-up sequences.
  • Compare discovery-call and qualification rates before and after without promising a lift.
sections.faq:
What does the free build include?

The scoped Lead Engine connects the agreed lead source and reply channel, uses examples you approve and includes a clear team handoff. Exact integrations are confirmed during the fit check.

What happens after the free build?

You can keep the focused workflow, add managed monitoring or scope a wider AI Operating System. There is no obligation to expand.

Who owns the system?

You own the prompts, connections and automations built in your accounts.
